rubric: A payments data migration that drops a column: wide, not undone by a revert, and the data is card tokens (all three at the top level). Risk is scored before the plan, from the record and the code map alone; complexity is how hard the change is to get right.

criteria.blast_radius: A subsystem, a contract others implement, or infrastructure
criteria.reversibility: Data or external state changes that a revert does not undo
criteria.complexity: Several modules, or a new mechanism

reading.why: Moving card tokens to a new vault and deleting the old column reaches a subsystem, cannot be undone by a revert and handles payment data: the top level on all three. Several modules and a new store make it L.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: S
ruledOut.why: It is not a few lines in one place; a vault and a migration are involved.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: M
ruledOut.why: It spans the payments code, the vault client and a migration, more than one module.

ruledOut.question: complexity
ruledOut.label: XL
ruledOut.why: There is no staged rollout or redesign named in the goal, so L is the fair reading.
